About us

Caffeine Minds sp. z o.o. is part of the DM Investments capital group, which has been building IT systems and backing innovation in Poland for more than 20 years.

The group's key company, Graffiti ERP S.A., has been producing its own ERP software for mid-sized and large manufacturing companies for over 20 years.

Caffeine Minds is the incubator for the most innovative ideas and technologies our team creates day to day.
